card.name: Start of long medical terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical word that is split into parts, such as vas-, hyp-, hypers-, Res-usc-itative or Abs-orption. It appears in allergy, hypersensitivity and emergency-treatment passages.

modes.label: Hyper/hypo words
modes.description: Opening pieces of hypersensitivity, hypoglycemia and hyposensitization.

modes.label: Other split terms
modes.description: Opening pieces of other long words such as vasectomy, vasomotor, resuscitative and absorption.
